notes.body: End of Promotion: BlackBerry Shake. Effective Sunday August 16 the Blackberry Milkshake mix-in promotion has concluded. Keep all blackberry promotional signage on display and continue selling until store inventory is fully depleted. Once inventory is gone, submit a Help Desk ticket with the exact subject line "Please Turn Off Blackberry" to remove the item from POS and Olo. No additional information is needed in the ticket.
